offering_description.value: Sells travel technology software and distribution services to airlines, travel agencies and corporate travel buyers. It delivers booking, airline operations and retailing systems through cloud platforms, and earns fees on bookings and software use.

primary_products.value: global distribution booking platform; airline passenger service systems; corporate travel booking software; airline retailing platform

primary_services.value: hosted technology operations; airline IT services; data and analytics; payment processing

customer_segment.value: B2B: airlines, travel agencies, corporate travel buyers, travel management companies

end_markets.value: air travel; travel agencies; corporate travel; airlines

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: fees per booking made through its distribution platform; subscription: recurring software and platform fees from airlines and travel agencies; service fees: fees for IT operations, implementation and support services
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates booking and distribution platform sold to airlines and travel agencies; service provider: runs hosted IT operations and outsourced technology services for airlines

geography_served.value: global: customers and travel bookings across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: global distribution, airline IT systems, airline retailing and corporate travel software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to airlines and large corporate accounts; partners / resellers: integration partners and technology resellers serving travel agencies; online: web-based booking tools used by travel agencies and corporate travelers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and payment security rules, plus airline distribution and competition rules that apply to booking systems

notes: Sabre sold its Hospitality Solutions business in 2025, so it is excluded here; the current scope may differ slightly from my knowledge.
